# wisp-science v1.19.0 — Remote web access

**Open your desktop Wisp from a phone or any browser, through a small relay you host yourself.**

The desktop connects out to a `wisp-relay` server; a browser opens `/remote#<code>` on the same relay and talks to the desktop through end-to-end encrypted frames. The relay sees only ciphertext. From the page you can switch projects and conversations, read Markdown replies with pictures, preview files, queue a message while a turn runs, send a photo, watch Runs, and see which other conversations wait for an approval. Mutating tools always ask on the desktop. This release also publishes the relay container image, adds a Full Permission shortcut on approval cards, makes the auto-compact threshold adjustable, and stops ACP agents together with the processes they started.

## Downloads

- **macOS**: signed and notarized DMG installers for Apple Silicon and Intel; compatible installations can update in-app.
- **macOS SwiftUI**: separate signed and notarized DMG installers for Apple Silicon and Intel, each with a SHA-256 checksum. The app is now named **Wisp Science SwiftUI.app** without the Preview label; quit and remove the old Preview app after installing it. Preferences are kept.
- **Windows**: MSI and NSIS installers. Windows release signing is currently disabled, so these installers remain unsigned.
- **Linux**: deb and AppImage packages for x86_64 and aarch64.
- **Relay image**: `ghcr.io/xuzhougeng/wisp-relay:1.19.0` and `:latest` for amd64 and arm64, published by this release. `:main` follows the main branch between releases.

Installers will appear in Assets as the platform builds finish. The Windows WinUI 3 preview remains available through native-preview workflow artifacts or a local source build; it does not replace the regular Windows installer.

## Remote web access

- **Settings → Remote Access → Remote web access** takes the relay URL and token (kept in the keyring) and shows the connection code, a copy-link button, a reset-code button and the number of connected browsers. One relay serves many computers: each code derives its own rendezvous id.
- The relay forwards AES-256-GCM frames and only sees a hash of the code. Frames are direction-bound and carry a per-connection nonce and a strictly increasing sequence, so the relay cannot reflect, replay or reorder them. The page is vanilla JS served with a strict CSP.
- The page follows the desktop layout: the project's conversations on the left with a project picker, the conversation in the middle, its files on the right; a phone shows one pane at a time. The URL fragment carries the route after the code, so Back, reload and bookmarks work.
- Replies render as Markdown with pictures. Tool calls fold into one "Ran N steps" row per finished turn, like the desktop. Long names are cut with an ellipsis and wide tables scroll inside their pane.
- Files: browse the conversation's project folder; text, Markdown and the documents the desktop already extracts are rendered, images open as pictures. Reads are local and text only; nothing can be downloaded.
- While a turn runs, Send becomes Queue. A queued remote message keeps the remote approval floor when it starts. Remote browsers can cancel a queued message; editing, reordering and cutting into the running turn stay on the desktop.
- Send one picture per message; the desktop bounds it at 768 KiB and attaches it so a vision model sees it. Run cards show state, elapsed time and the end of their output. A bell in the header counts the other conversations that need you.
- Remote turns run with the IM origin, so writes, edits and shell always ask. Terminal input, kernel execution, file save, ACP and permanent approval scopes are not reachable from the page.

Deploy the relay with Docker and Caddy in a few lines, or on Sealos without a server of your own. See [remote access](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.19.0/docs/remote-access.md), the [tutorial](https://wispscience.com/tutorials/wisp-science-remote-web.html) and the [Sealos tutorial](https://wispscience.com/tutorials/wisp-science-sealos-remote-web.html).

## Conversations and settings

- Tool approval cards get a **Full Permission** button next to Deny. It opens the same warning as the agent-menu toggle; confirming enables the mode for the conversation and approves the waiting request.
- **Settings → Session → Auto-compact threshold (%)** moves the context warning and automatic compaction trigger (default 80, range 10–95).
- A conversation with subagents, branches or explorations folds them behind one chevron in the sidebar, with a count when closed. Each nested row carries its kind icon.
- A follow-up folded into the running turn with Guide now no longer leaves a stale "waiting" row in the composer queue.
- The default model on a subscription card can be removed; another chat model takes over.
- A custom MCP connector whose tool name collides with a built-in is no longer rejected. The colliding tools are exposed as `<connector>__<tool>`.

## Fixes and safety

- Stopping an ACP agent (Codex, Claude Code) now stops the processes it started too, on Windows and Unix. Quitting the app shuts down every ACP session. On Windows this ends the helper processes that kept the agent executable open.
- Dangerous-command previews keep the whole command visible, and every recursive or force `rm` spelling is gated, not just `-rf`.
- Non-ASCII identifiers no longer abort the process in the Sanger and JASPAR validators or the artifact-token prefix.
- OOXML relationship files are parsed with a real XML parser, so an external target cannot hide inside an attribute. Sync-relay responses are bounded per chunk and have connect and read timeouts. Importing a skill folder refuses symlinks.

## Native apps

- The SwiftUI app adds publication evidence editing, the research assistant with persistent automations, document viewers, an editable workflow canvas, Hooks and research journey interactions.

The native apps are still not feature-complete. The SwiftUI app requires macOS 13+, installs alongside the regular app and shares its project data, settings and keyring. It updates by manual download. The regular WebView app and its updater remain available.

# wisp-science v1.19.0 — 远程访问

**通过一台自己托管的小型中继，从手机或任意浏览器打开桌面端的 Wisp。**

桌面端主动连接到 `wisp-relay` 服务器；浏览器在同一中继上打开 `/remote#<连接码>`，通过端到端加密的帧与桌面端通信，中继只能看到密文。在网页上可以切换项目和对话、阅读带图片的 Markdown 回复、预览文件、在回合运行时排队发送消息、发送照片、查看 Run 进展，以及看到哪些其他对话在等待审批。修改类工具始终在桌面端询问。本版本还发布了中继容器镜像，在审批卡片上增加“完全权限”快捷按钮，让自动压缩阈值可调，并在停止 ACP Agent 时一并结束它启动的进程。

## 下载

- **macOS**：Apple Silicon 与 Intel 的 DMG 安装包，签名并公证；兼容版本可在应用内更新。
- **macOS SwiftUI 版**：独立的 Apple Silicon 与 Intel DMG 安装包，签名并公证，各附 SHA-256 校验文件。应用现在命名为 **Wisp Science SwiftUI.app**，不再带“预览”字样；安装后请退出并删除旧的 Preview 应用，偏好设置会保留。
- **Windows**：MSI 与 NSIS 安装包。目前正式签名仍关闭，安装包暂未签名。
- **Linux**：x86_64 与 aarch64 的 deb、AppImage 安装包。
- **中继镜像**：本版本发布 `ghcr.io/xuzhougeng/wisp-relay:1.19.0` 与 `:latest`，支持 amd64 和 arm64。`:main` 在两个版本之间跟随主分支。

各平台构建完成后，安装包会陆续出现在 Assets。Windows WinUI 3 预览版仍通过 native-preview 工作流产物或本地源码构建获取，不替代常规 Windows 安装包。

## 远程网页访问

- **设置 → 远程访问 → 远程网页访问**填写中继地址和令牌（保存在密钥环中），显示连接码、复制链接按钮、重置连接码按钮和已连接的浏览器数量。一台中继可服务多台电脑：每个连接码派生各自的会合标识。
- 中继转发 AES-256-GCM 帧，只能看到连接码的哈希。帧绑定方向，携带每个连接的随机数和严格递增的序号，中继无法反射、重放或重排。网页是原生 JS，带严格的 CSP。
- 页面沿用桌面端布局：左侧是项目的对话列表和项目选择器，中间是对话，右侧是文件；手机上一次只显示一栏。URL 片段在连接码之后携带路由，后退、刷新和书签都可用。
- 回复以 Markdown 渲染并显示图片。已结束回合的工具调用折叠为一行“执行了 N 步”，与桌面端一致。过长的名称用省略号截断，过宽的表格在自己的栏内滚动。
- 文件：浏览对话所属项目的目录；文本、Markdown 和桌面端已能提取的文档会被渲染，图片以图片打开。读取仅限本地且仅限文本，无法下载任何文件。
- 回合运行时，“发送”变为“排队”。排队的远程消息开始运行时保持远程审批下限。远程浏览器可以取消排队的消息；编辑、重排和插入正在运行的回合仍留在桌面端。
- 每条消息可发送一张图片；桌面端限制在 768 KiB 内，并作为附件传给视觉模型。Run 卡片显示状态、已用时间和输出末尾。页眉的铃铛统计其他需要你处理的对话。
- 远程回合以 IM 来源运行，因此写入、编辑和 shell 始终询问。终端输入、内核执行、文件保存、ACP 和永久审批范围无法从网页触达。

用 Docker 加 Caddy 几行即可部署中继，或在 Sealos 上免服务器部署。详见[远程访问说明](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.19.0/docs/remote-access.md)、[使用教程](https://wispscience.com/tutorials/wisp-science-remote-web.html)和 [Sealos 教程](https://wispscience.com/tutorials/wisp-science-sealos-remote-web.html)。

## 对话与设置

- 工具审批卡片在“拒绝”旁新增**完全权限**按钮。它打开与 Agent 菜单开关相同的警告；确认后为该对话启用此模式，并批准正在等待的请求。
- **设置 → 会话 → 自动压缩阈值（%）**可调整上下文警告和自动压缩的触发点（默认 80，范围 10–95）。
- 带有子代理、分支或探索的对话在侧栏中折叠到一个展开箭头之后，收起时显示数量。每个嵌套行带有自己的类型图标。
- 通过“引导”并入正在运行回合的后续消息，不再在输入框队列中留下过期的“等待”行。
- 订阅卡片上的默认模型可以移除，由另一个聊天模型接替。
- 自定义 MCP 连接器的工具名与内置工具冲突时不再被整体拒绝，冲突的工具以 `<连接器>__<工具>` 暴露。

## 修复与安全

- 停止 ACP Agent（Codex、Claude Code）时会一并停止它启动的进程，Windows 和 Unix 均适用。退出应用会关闭所有 ACP 会话。在 Windows 上，这解决了辅助进程占用 Agent 可执行文件的问题。
- 危险命令预览保留完整命令，所有递归或强制 `rm` 写法都会被拦截，而不只是 `-rf`。
- Sanger 与 JASPAR 校验器以及产物标记前缀处理非 ASCII 标识符时不再导致进程中止。
- OOXML 关系文件改用真正的 XML 解析器，外部目标无法藏在属性中。同步中继的响应按块设限，并有连接和读取超时。导入技能目录时拒绝符号链接。

## 原生应用

- SwiftUI 版新增文献证据编辑、带持久自动化的科研助理、文档查看器、可编辑的工作流画布，以及 Hooks 和研究历程交互。

原生应用尚未完全覆盖常规版本功能。SwiftUI 版要求 macOS 13+，与常规应用并存，共用项目数据、设置和密钥环，通过手动下载更新。常规 WebView 应用及其更新器仍可使用。
